svg.text: Where the scales live: per-tensor, per-channel and per-group
Red cell: one outlier weight. Its scale also serves every weight in the same green box.
Measured in these notes: an 8 × 256 matrix with one outlier, INT4, groups of 64
Smaller groups give smaller errors but more scales to store:
4-bit codes + one FP16 scale per 128 weights = 4 + 16/128 = 4.125 bits per weight.
